decisive_items: he reported that his cow had similar lesions on its teats
multiple painless nodules on the fingers
vesicles that ruptured and formed hemorrhagic crusts
response.rationale: Dairy farm exposure with cow teat lesions and nodular-vesicular hand lesions favor Paravaccinia (milker's nodule) over Orf (sheep-associated) and Erysipeloid (bacterial, no such nodular crusts).

rejected.why: Orf is typically associated with sheep/goats, not cows; cow exposure points to Paravaccinia.
Erysipeloid presents as erythematous plaques without nodular vesicles and hemorrhagic crusts; also lacks cow teat lesion link.
